principal.review_process: Read all ten actual texts and formulated principal scores before the independent agent preliminary count arrived; full independent receipt not read before writing this record. Retain any dimension disagreement.

all_required.entity_role: Identity, pronouns, dialogue participants and their roles remain resolvable and do not contradict the prompt or prior generated text without an explained change.
all_required.event_progression: Events form an understandable progression connected to the prompt; agents, objects and effects remain identifiable.
all_required.language: Malformed, contradictory or repeated language does not prevent ordinary literal understanding. A minor spelling or grammar error that leaves meaning clear is not an automatic failure.
all_required.completion: The response ends with a complete clause at a stable or resolved narrative point. An unfinished clause, dangling quotation, or unresolved nonsensical endpoint fails.

allowances: Personification and fantastic story premises are allowed. Physical implausibility alone is not failure.
New explicitly introduced characters and events are allowed.
No prescribed plot or exact wording is required; not every prompt fact must be repeated.
EOS is not required; a token-cap response can pass if the complete retained text ends coherently.
No output truncation, repair, reroll, alternate seed, or post-result prompt expansion.
A new proper name alone is not an identity or role error; failure needs a contradiction or genuinely unresolved agent relationship in the complete text.
rubric.judgment_rule: Read the complete unchanged output; cite exact text for every failure used. A row passes only when all four criteria pass. Apply this same frozen rubric to both arms and both numerical paths.

meaningful_improvement.interpretation: A majority of the fixed small packet becoming acceptable supports advancing an exploratory conversation integration milestone only; it does not qualify general conversation. Ordinary arm remains a control; one paired seed cannot establish geometric advantage.
